about: The game's bust kit round 4, November 18, 2026. Local candidate for owner review. Each part is its own painting on the 1254 × 1254 v1 canvas at (0, 0).
proposedCode: Yes. In src/bench/bust.ts, resolve heads by shape, shade, and age and apply the pairing exclusions when choosing a saved or seeded appearance. Register each applicable short-sleeve style and its colors. For both bustFor and bustOfLook, add the same-shade arms entry immediately above head when a short-sleeve top is selected. The existing bust.mjs renderer already draws the list of URLs in order.
